quarterly_data.quarter: Socionext press release: Annual Securities Report for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): consolidated net sales 200,834 million yen (+6.5%); product revenue 161,792 million yen (+10.4%) - although demand for Chinese telecommunications equipment products declined, sales grew from the second quarter on new Chinese automotive products that entered mass production and certain industrial equipment products - while NRE revenue fell to 38,325 million yen (-6.6%). Gross profit fell to 89,777 million yen (-13.6%) as the cost of sales ratio rose to 55.3% from 44.9% with the start of mass production of new products with relatively low gross margins; operating income was 12,354 million yen (-50.6%, margin 6.2%). R&D costs were 58,508 million yen and capital investment (including intangibles) 22,238 million yen, mainly IP for advanced automotive and data center & networking products and reticles / test boards for individual SoCs. By shipping destination, China was 80,669 million yen and the U.S. 22,099 million yen of sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales 200,834 million yen (+6.5%); product revenue 161,792 million yen (+10.4%); NRE 38,325 million yen (-6.6%); operating income 12,354 million yen (-50.6%); China 80,669 million yen

quarterly_data.quarter: Socionext press release: Annual Securities Report for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Design wins and orders: the design win amount in FY March 2026 was approximately 310 billion yen, down from around 360 billion yen the prior year, but the company says it secured large-scale design wins particularly in Data Center & Networking; the design win balance (estimated cumulative value of design wins for existing projects, at 120 yen to the dollar, not a guarantee of sales) rose to approximately 1.51 trillion yen at March 31, 2026, from approximately 960 billion yen at end-March 2022, and lets the company forecast sales trends through the fiscal year ending March 2028 to some extent. Orders received were 229,696 million yen (+34.3%) and outstanding orders 197,056 million yen (+25.7%), reflecting new products entering mass production. It typically takes more than 2 years from design win to product revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Design wins ~310 billion yen FY March 2026 (vs ~360 billion yen); design win balance ~1.51 trillion yen; orders received 229,696 million yen (+34.3%); outstanding orders 197,056 million yen (+25.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Socionext press release: Annual Securities Report for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Technology and product development: in FY March 2026 Socionext launched development of a number of custom SoCs on advanced processes, including SoCs for HPC applications and AI accelerator SoCs in the data center and network fields, and completed several tape-outs of custom SoCs on 5 nm and 3 nm with high-density packaging, including large-scale 2.5D integration with HBM, which are moving toward mass production. Projects on 7 nm and below made up 84% of NRE revenue. Upfront development covers 2 nm and 1.4 nm nodes with chiplets, CPO (co-packaged) technology for optical data transmission, 3D/5.5D packaging and its configurable 'Flexlets' chiplets, through close collaboration with Arm and TSMC and joint development with imec; it has built an advanced chiplet development platform and started providing an RTL-customizable chiplet design library.
quarterly_data.figure: 84% of NRE revenue from 7 nm and below; tape-outs on 5 nm / 3 nm with 2.5D HBM integration
